style: Rajasthani (Mewar and Bundi) miniature painting on aged handmade paper: fine ink outline, flat jewel colours (vermilion, saffron, deep green, lapis blue), touches of gold, patterned architecture and stylised trees and skies, faces in profile with almond eyes that carry clear emotion.
composition: Wide landscape, 1860 x 845 pixels. Every figure and building stays within the left 63 percent; the right 37 percent is calm, empty aged paper for text. No lettering, no halos, no caste or sect marks, no gore. All adults look clearly adult.

characters.vikram: King Vikram: a strong man of about forty, black moustache, first grey at the temples; at night a deep indigo tunic, plain turban and a sword at the waist.
characters.betal: Betal: the spirit in a hanged man's body, a lean grey-blue figure in a simple pale cloth, long loose hair, closed eyes and a faint knowing smile; eerie, never gory.
characters.kshantishil: Kshantishil: a quiet middle-aged ascetic with a sun-darkened face and faded undyed cloth, clean of any forehead mark, thread or sect ornament.
characters.prince: Prince Vajramukut: a slender young man, thin moustache, saffron coat and a turban with one feather.
characters.friend: Buddhisharir, the minister's son: a young man with watchful eyes, deep green coat, plain turban.
characters.padmavati: Padmavati: an adult young woman, composed and intelligent, vermilion skirt, green odhni, lotus-gold jewellery.
characters.mandaravati: Mandaravati: an adult young woman with a long plait, simple yellow and river-blue clothes, a clay water pot.
characters.three-suitors: Three young scholars from Kanyakubja in plain white lower cloths and shawls: one reserved and upright, one soft-faced with a singer's open mouth, one with ink-stained fingers.
characters.three-brothers: Three well-groomed adult brothers in fine pale clothes: the eldest stout with a cloth held near his nose, the middle one preening, the youngest soft and delicate.
characters.prasenajit: King Prasenajit: an older king with a grey beard, curious amused eyes, deep green and gold robes.
